author: Kushal
problem: Read N, S, K and N lines of price P_i and quantity Q_i. Shipping is free if the total price is at least S and costs K otherwise. Print the total price plus shipping.
bug_description: Uses amount > s instead of amount >= s, so a total of exactly S is still charged shipping.

comments.accurate: Prints the order total, adding the K shipping fee unless the total reaches S
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints the order total, adding the K shipping fee unless the total is over S
comments.wrong_location: Shipping threshold verified; check that the products are summed over all N items

source.buggy_line: print(amount if amount > s else amount + k)
source.fixed_line: print(amount if amount >= s else amount + k)
